_comment: Copy to local_inputs.json (git-ignored) and set the paths for this machine. Paths may be absolute, start with ~, or be relative to this file. The hashes identify the reviewed files; do not change them unless the team reviews a new snapshot.

source.identity_limit: The CSV preamble does not name the fund; its link to XIU rests on this reviewed file hash, not on the file name or URL.
